cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Reopen the First Reason
cards.instruction: Keep them present by returning to the first reason for staying and revealing that it now means something different.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's handle this professionally. Don't go yet. You came to return the key.

mechanism: A supervises a key return so its first practical purpose becomes an unresolved invitation to remain in the relationship.
confusable: D169 shares responsibility; D218 keeps someone through a reinterpreted original reason.
comparison: Physical key/ongoing access differs from an attentive tea farewell.
seedUse: Keep key-on-table fact; make later choices concrete without inventing a specific breakup backstory.
